items.title: Matched Capabilities, Different Behaviors: A Controlled Study of MCP and CLI Interfaces for Language Agents
items.summary: Matched interface representations significantly alter agent behavior despite identical executable capabilities, and targeted repair of interface-specific realization improves performance while reducing cost.

items.title: EPSBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Earnings Forecasting
items.summary: The study introduces EPSBench to evaluate AI agents in forecasting quarterly earnings by linking financial evidence to income-statement drivers and comparing model predictions to analyst consensus.

items.title: Weaken to Strengthen: Weakening-Induced On-Policy Self-Distillation for Large Reasoning Models
items.summary: WISD improves reasoning models by contrasting them with weaker quantized or pruned versions to generate training signals without privileged data.

items.title: Training Foundation Models with a Single Algorithm
items.summary: Foundation-model training stages can be unified under a single likelihood-based algorithm that blends static data and reinforcement learning generations, improving efficiency and capability retention.

items.title: Online Dense Reinforcement Learning with Planning-Grounding Agent for UI Navigation on Live IOS Apps
items.summary: An online reinforcement learning framework trains UI navigation agents on live mobile apps using a planning agent, UI grounding model, and a novel neighbor-conditioned value estimation method to improve robustness and reduce inference costs.

items.title: Scaling Lean Theorem Proving for Real-World Code Verification
items.summary: EasyProver is a Lean proving system using recursive agents and asynchronous search that solves nearly all Putnam and IMO benchmark problems, while Aegis generates harder verification tasks from competitive programming to benchmark provers and support reinforcement learning.

items.title: ABF-Bench: A Verifiable Benchmark for Agentic Blockchain Forensics
items.summary: ABF-Bench introduces an interactive, evidence-backed benchmark for blockchain fund tracing that evaluates adaptive agents against fixed tracers, revealing gaps in recall and overconfidence while enabling verifiable LLM agent training.

items.title: Proving and Improving the Platonic Representation Hypothesis with JEPAs
items.summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures trained on aligned multi-modal observations converge to shared representations with far greater efficiency than next-token prediction, demonstrating that positive view design—not scale alone—drives cross-modal alignment.

items.title: SO-101 Bench: Accessible Spatial Manipulation
items.summary: A simulated benchmark for language-conditioned spatial manipulation on low-cost robot arms reveals that hybrid LLM agents outperform learned vision-language-action policies, with ranking consistency between simulation and real hardware.

items.title: OpenFlyV2: An onboard vision-language-action model for aerial perception and navigation
items.summary: OpenFlyV2 is a unified onboard vision-language-action model that enables real-time aerial navigation and reasoning on resource-constrained hardware using shared multimodal representations.

items.title: Investor's Last Exam: Can AI Agents Do Equity Investment Without Seeing the Future?
items.summary: Investor's Last Exam evaluates financial agents on end-to-end equity research using frozen evidence, expert criteria, and dependency graphs, revealing that top models excel at research but fail at forecasting and investment judgments.

items.title: Broken on Arrival: Non-Functional Quantized LLM Artifacts in Public Model Registries and How to Catch Them
items.summary: Quantized small language model files in public registries can be non-functional due to uncalibrated quantization recipes, and screening plus calibration is recommended before release.

items.title: Co-Design Bench: Multimodal Collaborative Coding Evaluation for Agentic Models
items.summary: Evaluating human-AI co-design requires testing whether coding agents can translate real users' multimodal requests into working application revisions. We introduce Co-Design Bench, a reference-free benchmark of 273 tasks curated from 37,463 deduplicated queries across 26,314 real user coding sessions. Its two tracks, Multimodal Editing (ME) and Repository Editing (RE), cover localized edits with optional image, audio, video, or document inputs and coordinated repository revisions. Tasks span three capability dimensions: Grounded Understanding, UI Transformation, and Functional Implementation. The tasks pair normalized requests and runnable pre-edit applications with 2,331 hidden expert-authored acceptance criteria. Our judge-then-refute protocol grades criteria using source and browser evidence, challenges positive verdicts with a separate LLM verifier, and audits visual and interaction claims without gold code or target screenshots. Under a shared agentic harness, the strongest of ten model endpoints passes an average of 69.9% of criteria per task but fully satisfies only 26.4% of tasks. All ten endpoints achieve lower criterion completion on repository edits spanning three or four change types than on those spanning one or two. Co-Design Bench provides a testbed for studying the gap between partial requirement satisfaction and complete task success under agentic execution for real-user application revisions.

items.title: PersonaCUABench: Benchmarking Computer-Use Agents Serving Diverse Personas
items.summary: PersonaCUABench reveals that computer-use agents frequently fail to satisfy real user requirements and constraints, reducing task completion and satisfaction compared to fixed benchmark instructions.

items.title: Evaluating DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 for loss of control and harmful manipulation risks
items.summary: Independent safety evaluation of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 reveals substantial improvements over prior versions and near-parity with leading closed-source models, while recommending process-level observability, incremental safety testing, and private benchmarks.

items.title: Amortizing Sequential Experimental Design in Reasoning LLMs
items.summary: Large language models learn adaptive information gathering by training reasoning with information-gain rewards, improving experimental design efficiency and generalizing across tasks.

items.title: RealCLI: Toward a Unified Evaluation of Human-Agent Collaboration for CLI Agents
items.summary: REALCLI is a benchmark that jointly evaluates CLI agent task execution and human-agent collaboration quality, revealing major gaps in steerability, trust calibration, and safety management.

items.title: Unlocking Any-Order Generation in Pretrained Autoregressive Image Models
items.summary: Pretrained raster-scan autoregressive image models can be adapted into flexible any-order generators via future-aware positional embeddings and an ordering curriculum, enabling inpainting and outpainting with minimal extra compute.

items.title: Multi-Token Prediction Done Right
items.summary: Soft-MTP removes a noisy gradient residual from multi-token prediction via a straight-through KL recovery trick, improving perplexity, speculative decoding, and reasoning without added cost.

items.title: A-RSI: Adaptive Task Refresh for Zero-Data Multimodal Self-Improvement
items.summary: A-RSI improves recursive self-improvement by refreshing training tasks based on declining learning signals and using independently verifiable program-generated answers, raising benchmark performance without external labels.

items.title: WebAnything: From the Wild Web to Scalable Agent Environments
items.summary: WebAnything automates the reconstruction of reusable, source-grounded web environments from real URLs, enabling scalable agent training and evaluation with verified fidelity.

items.title: WorkFactory: Turning Professional Intents into Executable Work for Scalable Agent Training
items.summary: WorkFactory builds coherent professional tasks via information planning and repair, yielding WorkPilot models that improve expert-level agent performance across benchmarks.

items.title: Instruction Capacity: Behavior and Degradation of Language Models under Controlled Load
items.summary: Researchers developed a statistical instrument using atomic replacement rules to measure language model instruction capacity with quantified uncertainty, finding GPT-4o mini holds about 37-38 rules at 95% accuracy.

items.title: EditAgent: Rethinking Agentic Image Editing
items.summary: EditAgent broadens agentic image editing by routing steps to diverse editors and using verification records for listwise judging, improving reliability and efficiency.

items.title: VibeGame: Prompt-to-Game Development with AI-Native Engine and Self-Evolving Adversarial Agent Team
items.summary: VibeGame is a framework that uses specialized adversarial agents and an AI-native engine to build complete 2D games from natural-language prompts with interactive validation and self-evolving reusable components.

items.title: Know, then Draw: A New Learning Paradigm for Visual Generation
items.summary: A hybrid paradigm combining autoregressive pretraining for semantics and diffusion post-training for rendering achieves efficient, high-quality text-to-image generation with favorable scaling laws.

items.title: LongZero: Enhancing Long-Context Reasoning in LLMs from Zero Data
items.summary: LongZero enables large language models to self-improve long-context reasoning by synthesizing structured multi-hop and retrieval tasks and training with GRPO without external data.

items.title: CausGround: Causal Interaction Grounding for Adaptive Embodied Planning
items.summary: CausGround extracts reusable action preconditions and effects from interaction experience to improve embodied planning and reasoning across diverse environments without model retraining.

items.title: Youtu-Parsing-Omni: One Encoder, One Schema, All Modalities
items.summary: Youtu-Parsing-Omni is a unified multi-modal parser that encodes documents, images, audio, and video into structured spatiotemporal records using shared weights and cross-modal fusion, achieving state-of-the-art results across parsing benchmarks through a self-evolving on-policy distillation procedure.

items.title: Glance: The Generator Is Its Own Reranker
items.summary: Glance integrates reranking and generation into a single backbone using lightweight adapters and pointer heads to score passages from shared context, reducing memory overhead while improving retrieval and answer quality.

items.title: Your LR Schedule May Not Be Principled: Effective Learning Rate Scheduling in Weight-Normalized Training
items.summary: Effective learning rate trajectories primarily drive weight-normalized training gains, motivating an affine inverse-square-root schedule that improves large-scale pretraining loss and robustness.

items.title: Your Benchmark Is an Empirical Measure Over Difficulty
items.summary: This work formalizes benchmark evaluation through difficulty measures, identifies failure modes of measure mismatch and coverage gaps, and proposes diagnostic metrics and a rewriting algorithm to improve benchmark coverage.

items.title: AskStream: When and What to Ask Proactively under Uncertainty in Streaming Video Understanding
items.summary: Proactive video understanding should include asking for missing information under uncertainty, and the AskStream benchmark reveals current models struggle with this decision.

items.title: WeVisCut: The Whole Editing Room in One Agent From Narration to Long-Form Video
items.summary: WeVisCut is a script-to-video system that trains a compact policy to coordinate video editing tools, recover from failures, and reduce token usage while maintaining quality.

items.title: After One-Click Video: The Inflow of Service-Type Content, the Failure of the Recommendation Pool Mechanism, and the BoLe System
items.summary: AI-generated video tools shift content production toward service-type material, unbalancing the industry and overwhelming recommendation systems, prompting a dual-judgment BoLe framework to protect work-type content.

items.title: PreView: Enhancing GUI Grounding with Preprocessed Views and Cues
items.summary: PreView is an auxiliary preprocessor that enhances GUI grounding by providing localized zoomed views and visual-textual target cues to frozen grounding models, improving accuracy without retraining.

items.title: TauIndianBankBench: Procedure-Aware, Action-Oriented Evaluation of Tool-Using Conversational Agents
items.summary: TauIndianBankBench evaluates language model assistants on Indian retail banking by verifying both procedural compliance and final outcomes across 1,000 simulated tasks.

items.title: Holo4D: Holistic 4D Reconstruction as Geometric Control for Video Diffusion
items.summary: Holo4D guides video diffusion with reconstructed 3D trajectory scaffolds to synthesize novel-view videos while preserving geometry and motion.

items.title: L3G-World: Real-Time Infinite World Generation with Latent 3D Gaussian Memory
items.summary: L3G-World uses a compact latent 3D Gaussian memory and alternating autoregressive updates with a video diffusion transformer to generate spatially consistent interactive worlds in real time.

items.title: Look Only When Needed: Certificate-Guided Visual Routing for Efficient Diffusion VLMs
items.summary: LOWN adaptively skips image processing during diffusion vision-language model decoding when predictions agree, reducing computation while preserving accuracy.

items.title: A Broader Look into MLLM's Retrieval Heads
items.summary: Retrieval heads remain sparse and shared across audio-visual modalities, and optimizing them improves document retrieval performance in multimodal models.

items.title: LOB-Impact Benchmark: Emergent Market Impact in Generative Limit Order Book Models
items.summary: Neural generative limit order book models trained for next-token prediction exhibit emergent market impact under metaorder injection, though relaxation decay remains unobserved due to limited context windows.

items.title: FDSML: Formula-Driven Supervised Metric Learning with Parameter-Aware Triplet Loss
items.summary: Formula-driven supervised metric learning uses continuous generative parameters to train embeddings with parameter-aware triplet loss, improving synthetic pre-training for image retrieval and robustness.

items.title: PhysInsert: Physically Plausible Object Insertion with Geometric Priors and Bidirectional Object-Scene Interactions
items.summary: PhysInsert enables physically plausible object insertion by jointly adapting objects and scenes using geometry-guided adaptation and spatial supervision on aligned counterfactual data.

items.title: AB-Attention: Accurate Block Attention for Accelerating Video Diffusion Transformers
items.summary: AB-Attention approximates dense video diffusion attention with high sparsity via intra-block clustering, weighted sampling, and fine-grained kernel gathering, improving fidelity and speed.

items.title: Read, Allocate, Route: Role-Coupled Tokenization for Pixel-Space Generative Transformers
items.summary: SpecSlot improves pixel-space generative Transformers by using localized spectral slots and restricted global attention to increase image detail without raising computational cost.

items.title: CoSTA: Compressed Speech Token Adaptation for Efficient Spoken Dialogue Models
items.summary: CoSTA decouples generation and synthesis token spaces to accelerate spoken dialogue models while preserving quality and compatibility.

items.title: Intrinsic Distribution Matching
items.summary: Intrinsic Distribution Matching improves few-step text-to-image generation by adding explicit moment constraints to distribution matching distillation, achieving state-of-the-art long-text rendering with minimal network evaluations.

items.title: IntReal: A Real-World Dataset and Benchmark for Multimodal Interleaved Generation
items.summary: IntReal introduces a real-world interleaved multimodal dataset and evaluation framework to diagnose unified model strengths and improve generation through targeted training.

items.title: HairDeck: Animation-Ready Stylized Hair Cards from a Single Image
items.summary: HairDeck generates stylized hair cards and spring-bone animations as unordered token sets using a diffusion transformer, improving accuracy and speed over prior methods.
